TATA TECHNOLOGIES SHARES JUMP 10% ON FY30 REVENUE TARGET

On 19 November 2026 Tata Technologies shares rose 10% to a one‑month high after the company announced a FY30 revenue goal of $1.1‑$1.3 billion, compared with about $620 million in FY26.
The plan includes expanding aerospace and industrial machinery, doubling the software business in three years and targeting $100 million aerospace revenue by FY28, signalling strong growth ambition for the engineering services sector.

For information only. Not investment advice.
